sara_support: Customer C-8421 seeing inconsistent embedding dims from /v1/embeddings. Intermittent 1536 vs expected 1024 leading to downstream reshape failures. Happened ~50/500 calls in 1h after SDK upgrade.

matt_eng: Can you paste a raw request/response? SDK version? any batching config?

sara_support: They upgraded to python-embed-sdk v1.7.2 yesterday. Batch_size=32, timeout=5s. Error from their app: "ValueError: cannot reshape array of size 4608 into shape (3,1024)". Attached logs show response vector length 1536 for some items.

jia_ml: That smells like mixed model variants being routed (1024 vs 1536). But intermittent suggests batching or retry duplication. Could be our batching code concatenating caches incorrectly.

nate_oncall: @matt_eng @jia_ml I'll repro locally. Any quick mitigation for customer?

matt_eng: Ask them to pin server-side model to 'embed-base-1024' for now and disable client-side batching: set batch_size=1. Also increase timeout to 15s.

sara_support: Sent workaround. They reported it stops failing but throughput is bad.

matt_eng: Repro steps I ran:
```python
from embed_sdk import EmbeddingClient
client = EmbeddingClient(api_key="REDACTED")
# batch_size=32, timeout=5
texts = ["sample text"] * 100
resp = client.embed(texts, batch_size=32, timeout=5)
# occasionally some responses len==1536
```

jia_ml: I see a race in the client: when a retried batch gets merged into the wrong subsequent batch; duplicate tokenization offsets could corrupt the request shape. Adding request-id header would help tracing.

nate_oncall: Opening internal bug: INF-4627. I'll attach traces and sample responses. Also raising rate-limit and timeout suggestion: implement exponential backoff + jitter and per-batch request-id.

matt_eng: Quick patch: ensure batch assembly deep-copies token offsets and include X-Request-ID. Also guard against stale KV cache across retries.

deploy-bot: deploy started for embed-client v1.7.3-hotfix -> succeeded

sara_support: Customer confirmed v1.7.3 hotfix fixed dims. Leaving open for longer run. Thanks all :tada:

matt_eng: Follow-ups: add unit test for batch-retry interleaving, add end-to-end test against deduped request-ids, and update SDK docs about recommended timeout/backoff for embeddings.

sara_support: Filing a postmortem link: https://internal.redwood/pm/INF-4627

nate_oncall: Marking P1->P2 after fix and customer validation.
